# dsclimtools

The goal of dsclimtools is to interact with the dsclim dataset. To do
so, this package provide functions that allow to read the data into R
objects of the `stars` class (from the `stars` package). It also provide
a few functions to modify and manipulate these objects (e.g. modify
dates, change units, etcetera).

## Installation

You can install the development version of dsclimtools like so:

``` r

library(devtools)
install_github("dinilu/dsclimtools")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`.read_dsclim()`](http://dnietolugilde.com/dsclimtools/reference/dot-read_dsclim.md)
  : Load cropped dsclim files
- [`read_dsclim()`](http://dnietolugilde.com/dsclimtools/reference/read_dsclim.md)
  : Load dsclim files
- [`calendar_dates()`](http://dnietolugilde.com/dsclimtools/reference/calendar_dates.md)
  : Create calendar dates
- [`time_2_calendar_dates()`](http://dnietolugilde.com/dsclimtools/reference/time_2_calendar_dates.md)
  : Modify time to calendar years
- [`read_trace()`](http://dnietolugilde.com/dsclimtools/reference/read_trace.md)
  : Read TraCE21ka datasets
- [`kelvin2celsius()`](http://dnietolugilde.com/dsclimtools/reference/kelvin2celsius.md)
  : Degrees Kelvin to Celsius
- [`flux2mm()`](http://dnietolugilde.com/dsclimtools/reference/flux2mm.md)
  : Flux 2 millimetters
